name: Janus Henderson Anemoy Treasury Fund
oneLiner: JTRSY is Anemoy's tokenized short-duration U.S. Treasury fund sub-advised by Janus Henderson; whitelisted investors subscribe and redeem at fund NAV same-day.
collateral: Short-duration U.S. Treasury bills selected and managed by Janus Henderson as sub-advisor inside Anemoy's BVI Professional Fund, tokenised through Centrifuge as ERC-7540 vault shares
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting fund share token; same-day subscription and redemption at fund NAV for whitelisted non-U.S. Professional Investors via the Centrifuge issuer rail; S&P assigns AA+f / S1+ to the fund

proofOfReserves.provider: Centrifuge on-chain NAV publishing with Janus Henderson sub-advisory; S&P AA+f / S1+ rating

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Anemoy / Centrifuge operate JTRSY with permissioned ERC-7540 vault transfers restricted to whitelisted Professional Investors and retain freeze and burn authority over fund shares.
